senses.gloss: f.(b. h. כְּתֹבֶת ; preced. wds.) writing, inscription; כ׳ קעקע etched-in inscription on the skin (Lev. XIX, 28).
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:6">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>שנמצאת כ׳ ק׳ חקוקה וכ׳</he> an etched-in writing was found on his (Jojakim’s) body.
<cite ref="Gittin 20b:2">Gitt. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>בכ׳ ק׳</he> in the case of the slave’s emancipation being etched in on his hand (so as to be indelible).
